# descope_lokalise_connector (Resource)

Manages a Lokalise connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Localize the language of your login and user journey screens with the Lokalise connector. Screen texts are pushed to your Lokalise project as keys, translated inside Lokalise by your team, and pulled back once ready.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Lokalise API token. The token must belong to a user that can manage keys in the project (Owner/Admin recommended).
- `config_project_id` (String) Lokalise project ID.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
